Wrote [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).

Root cause is `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` in config `generation 119`. Pool of 20 saturates. Churn hits 4180 opens per 5m against a baseline of 40.

Window runs `02:14:18.972Z` to `03:59:27.974Z`, 530 `503`s. **The log ends still erroring, so treat this as live.** Counts are `node-3 of 3` only.

Roll back `dep-4471`. Faster still, flip `perRequest` back to `false` and reload.
